name: Ozinexus Enquiry Rescue Popup
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.description:
Ozinexus Enquiry Rescue Popup helps website owners recover potential enquiries that might otherwise be lost when visitors leave a page without contacting the business.

The plugin displays a lightweight popup based on visitor intent signals such as exit movement, time delay, or scroll depth. Visitors can quickly submit their contact details or use quick actions like WhatsApp or phone call.

All enquiries are stored securely inside WordPress and optionally sent via email notification.

The plugin is designed for service-based websites such as consultants, agencies, local businesses, and event services that rely on enquiries from visitors.

Developed by Ozinexus Technologies
https://www.ozinexustechnologies.com/

Features

  • Exit-intent popup detection
  • Time delay and scroll trigger options
  • Simple enquiry form with customizable fields
  • WhatsApp and call action buttons
  • Popup design customization (colors, width, border radius)
  • Popup positioning options
  • Device targeting (desktop, tablet, mobile)
  • Lead storage inside WordPress dashboard
  • Email notification for new enquiries
  • Basic analytics (views, opens, leads, clicks)
  • Cooldown system to avoid showing popup repeatedly
  • Optional urgency message and trust text
  • Contact page trigger support
  • CSV export of leads
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ozinexus-enquiry-rescue-popup directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Ozinexus Popup > Popup Builder in the admin menu.
  4. Configure the popup settings and enable the popup.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin loads lightweight assets only when the popup is enabled and uses simple JavaScript logic.

Where are leads stored?

All enquiries are saved inside WordPress and can be viewed under Ozinexus Popup > Leads.

Can I receive email notifications?

Yes. You can set the notification email in the popup settings.

Can I customize popup design?

Yes. You can change colors, text, layout, popup width, and logo.

Does the plugin work on mobile devices?

Yes. You can enable or disable popup display separately for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does this plugin send data to external servers?

No. All lead data is stored locally in your WordPress database. The only external communication that occurs is when a visitor clicks the WhatsApp or Call buttons, which opens the visitor’s own device app (wa.me or tel: link). No data is sent to Ozinexus Technologies or any third-party server.
